readout_other: Fibre photometry of LC GCaMP6s Ca2+ and GRAB-NE2m norepinephrine in LC and hippocampus; [18F]FDG PET; tail suspension positive control
direction_notes: Five-second trains raised LC calcium and gave a biphasic hippocampal NE change (initial rise then transient decrease) and reduced whole-brain FDG uptake with increased brown adipose tissue uptake; 30 s trains added a sustained secondary NE increase.

exposures.label: LC-targeted TUS (ON target) with OFF-target control 3 mm dorsal; intensity sweep and PRF/duration sweep

timing.protocol_description: Main protocol: 515 kHz, 0.65 W/cm2 Isppa, 20% DC, 2.5 Hz PRF, 5 s pulse train repeated 15 times with a 3 min stimulus onset asynchrony. Sweeps: five intensities from 0.06 to 2.55 W/cm2 at 20% DC, 2.5 Hz, 5 s; and 30 s trains at 0.5, 1 and 2 Hz PRF with the duty cycle adjusted to keep pulses at 80 ms and Isppa 0.65 W/cm2.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Experiments were conducted in 8 weeks old C57BL6/6 J mice (n = 14; 7/ 7 M/F, Janvier, France)
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: 515 kHz fundamental frequency, 0.65 W/cm<sup>2</sup> spatial peak pulse-average intensity (Isppa), 20% duty cycle (DC), 2.5 Hz pulse repetition frequency (PRF), 5 s pulse train duration (PTD)
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.isppa_w_: 5 levels of ultrasound intensity, ranging between 0.06 and 2.55 W/cm<sup>2</sup>
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: 515 kHz fundamental frequency, 0.65 W/cm<sup>2</sup> spatial peak pulse-average intensity (Isppa), 20% duty cycle (DC), 2.5 Hz pulse repetition frequency (PRF), 5 s pulse train duration (PTD)
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: 515 kHz fundamental frequency, 0.65 W/cm<sup>2</sup> spatial peak pulse-average intensity (Isppa), 20% duty cycle (DC), 2.5 Hz pulse repetition frequency (PRF), 5 s pulse train duration (PTD)
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: three different PRFs were tested: 0.5, 1, and 2 Hz
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: with the DC adjusted per PRF to keep the pulse duration at 80 ms
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: a single-element ring transducer, the PhoCUS (photometrycoupled ultrasonic stimulation) device

flags.reason: Sweep recorded as [min, max]; the main protocol 0.65 W/cm2 and a 1.43 W/cm2 level fall between them. Domain not stated (calibrated in water with an implanted skull in the path).
20% applies to the 2.5 Hz protocol; in the 30 s PRF sweep the duty cycle was adjusted per PRF and the values are not stated.
List combines 2.5 Hz (main protocol) with 0.5, 1 and 2 Hz (sweep); quote covers the sweep sentence.
80 ms stated for the PRF sweep; equals 20% of the 400 ms period of the main protocol (not stated directly).
5 s main protocol, 30 s in the PRF sweep; quote is the main protocol sentence.
Transducer maker not named; custom matching network built by the authors, transducer origin only cited.
Authors state an auditory contribution cannot be excluded and no deafening or masking was used.
OFF-target condition 3 mm dorsal still delivered about 61% of ON-target intensity at the LC.
